文件夹的层级就是分类的层级：选的文件夹是最外层，里面的子文件夹是它的子分类。同一: Folders become nested categories: the folder you picked is the top level and its subfolders are sub-categories. A PDF that sits in several folders is imported once and placed in all of those categories.
导入后不会自动翻译，只准备原页；想读哪篇再翻译哪篇。可以重复导入同一个文件夹，已: Nothing is translated automatically; pages are only prepared, so translate the papers you want to read. You can import the same folder again: papers already here only get their categories updated, nothing is duplicated.
这个文件夹里的 PDF 超过 {n} 个，请分几次导入，每次选一个子文件夹: This folder has more than {n} PDFs. Import it in parts, one subfolder at a time
这里只列还没译的 {n} 页，点页码选中。: Only the {n} untranslated pages are listed. Click page numbers to select them.
{pages} 模型整页漏译，单独再译一次: {pages}: the model skipped the whole page, translating it again on its own
此书签对应的段落已不存在: This bookmarked paragraph no longer exists
标记公式、图片或读到的位置，随时跳回来: Bookmark a formula, figure, or reading position to return to it
这条笔记对应的段落已不存在: The paragraph for this note no longer exists
还没有笔记，选中文字或点击段落即可添加；已有笔记会自动出现在这里: No notes yet. Select text or click a paragraph to add one; existing notes appear here automatically.
填有效的 HTTP 或 HTTPS 接口地址: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS base URL
点击定位正文，编辑请点编辑按钮: Click to locate in text; use Edit to change this note
这张图表已变化或移除，请重新关联: This figure or table has changed or been removed. Link it again.
图片未能加载，请查看原页: Image could not load. View the PDF page instead.
尚无图像，可查看 PDF 原页: No image is available yet. View the PDF page instead.
选择本文的图或表，之后可在笔记中展开查看: Choose a figure or table from this paper to view alongside your note.
已关联，点击图表名称展开: Linked. Click its name to expand.
图表已变化或移除: Figure or table changed or removed
点选图表，或直接把正文图片拖进笔记: Select a figure, or drag an image from the paper into a note
拖到笔记以关联图表: Drag onto a note to link this figure or table
点击展开或收起；双击名称或按 F2 改名: Click to expand or collapse; double-click the name or press F2 to rename
仅支持 PNG、JPEG 或 WebP 图片: Only PNG, JPEG or WebP images are supported.
图片读取失败，请重新粘贴: Could not read the image. Please paste it again.
图片过大，单张最多 8 MB: The image is too large. Each image can be up to 8 MB.
每次最多粘贴 4 张图片: You can attach up to 4 images per message.
请先停止当前回答后再粘贴图片: Stop the current answer before pasting an image.
输入问题，或粘贴截图…: Ask a question or paste a screenshot…
补充问题，或直接发送图片…: Add a question or send the image…
当前模型未启用看图，请选择支持图片的模型: The current model does not support images. Choose an image-capable model.
单张图片最多 8 MB，合计最多 20 MB: Images can be up to 8 MB each and 20 MB in total.
图片格式不支持或尺寸过大: The image format is unsupported or its dimensions are too large.
图片转存后过大，请缩小图片后重新粘贴: The decoded image is too large. Resize it and paste it again.
图片无法读取，请重新复制后粘贴: Could not read the image. Copy and paste it again.
单独列出图片中的标签、坐标轴和图例文字；关闭后仍翻译图片题注。仅影响之后翻译的内: List figure labels, axes and legends separately. Captions are still translated when disabled. Applies to future translations only.
请等本篇翻译完成后再裁图: Wait for this paper to finish translating before cropping.
在原页上拖出图片范围，保存后替换当前图片；题注保持不变。: Drag a rectangle on the original page to replace the image. The caption stays unchanged.
在原页上拖动选择截图范围: Drag on the original page to select a crop
可以重新拖动选择范围: Drag again to adjust the selection
原页加载失败，请稍后重试: Unable to load the page. Please try again.
已导出 Markdown 和图片；解压后一起放入笔记库: Markdown and images exported. Extract them together into your notes folder.
模型名填写 provider/model，可在终端运行 opencode mod: Enter provider/model (run opencode models to list them), or leave blank for the OpenCode default.
安装 OpenCode 并配置模型: Install OpenCode and configure a model
找不到 OpenCode 命令，请先安装并配置模型: OpenCode was not found. Install it and configure a model first.
仅影响之后的翻译；图片题注照常翻译: Applies to future translations; captions are still translated
修改后重启生效；多篇并行可能触发模型限流: Restart to apply; parallel papers may hit model rate limits
例如：KV cache 保留英文: For example: keep KV cache in English
默认提示词跟随界面语言；自行编辑的内容保留原文。格式、公式和逐句对齐由程序保留: The default prompt follows the interface language; your custom text stays as written. The app retains format, math and sentence alignment rules.
由浏览器管理下载位置: Download location managed by your browser
无法读取保存位置，请选择位置: Cannot read the save location; choose a location
例如：这篇论文中的 agent 保留英文: For example: keep agent in English in this paper
仅用于本次翻译；长期规则可在设置中编辑翻译提示词: Applies only to this translation; edit the translation prompt in Settings for lasting preferences
用于之后的翻译和重译，可调整风格与术语；格式、公式和逐句对齐由程序保留: Applies to future translations and retranslations. Edit style and terminology here; the app retains format, math and sentence alignment rules.
翻译提示词不能为空，最多 12000 字: The translation prompt cannot be empty; maximum 12,000 characters
PDF 处理内存不足，降低清晰度重试后仍未完成。请关闭占用内存较多的程序后重试。: PDF processing ran out of memory even after retrying at lower resolution. Close memory-heavy programs and retry.
点击放大图片；拖到笔记以关联图表: Click to enlarge; drag onto a note to link the figure
请确认 PDF 在本机可读取、文献库目录可写，并关闭占用大量内存的程序后重试。重: Make sure the PDF is available locally and the library folder is writable, then close memory-heavy programs and retry. Retrying only prepares original pages; it does not call a translation model.
使用本机 ZCode 登录态；模型和推理选项跟随 ZCode 设置，看图能力取决: Uses your local ZCode login and model settings. Image support depends on the selected model.
安装并登录 ZCode CLI: Install and sign in to ZCode CLI
跟随 ZCode 中选择的模型: Uses the model selected in ZCode
ZCode 跟随自身的模型设置，请在 ZCode 中切换模型和推理选项: Change the model and reasoning options in ZCode; EasyRead follows those settings.
ZCode 暂不支持额外参数，请清空 zcode.extra_args: Extra ZCode arguments are not supported yet. Clear zcode.extra_args.
尚未保存成功，请保持标签打开，稍后重试: Could not save. Keep the tab open and retry.
请先选中要翻译的文字: Select some text to translate first
选中文字过长，请分段翻译（每次最多 12000 字符）: Selection is too long. Translate in sections (up to 12,000 characters at a time).
模型没有返回译文，请重试: The model returned no translation. Please try again.
翻译选中文字，学习词义和用法: Translate the selection and learn meanings and usage
当前浏览器不支持朗读: Speech synthesis is not supported in this browser
未找到本地语音，请在系统中安装对应语言的语音包: No local voice found. Install a voice for this language in your system settings.
朗读失败，请重试或检查系统语音: Could not read aloud. Retry or check your system voices.
未找到本地英音，请在系统中安装英语（英国）语音包: No local British voice found. Install an English (UK) voice in system settings.
未找到本地美音，请在系统中安装英语（美国）语音包: No local American voice found. Install an English (US) voice in system settings.
